research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: SiPhox Health is researching and developing diagnostic infrastructure for home and central labs, focusing on bodily fluid collection assemblies with microfluidic and chemical lining features, apparatuses for detecting analytes using biosensors and microfluidic devices, integrated silicon photonic biosensors for plate readers, wearable biosensors for real-time analyte monitoring, and systems for allergen detection, fluid sensing using passive flow, and respiratory disease testing. These areas collectively advance biosensing and diagnostic technologies.

about_short_description.short_description: SiPhox Health builds diagnostic infrastructure both for the home and the central lab.

product.name: At-Home Blood Testing
product.description: A service that enables individuals to collect blood samples at home for testing key health biomarkers without venous draws or lab visits.

product.name: Biomarker Analysis Panels
product.description: Comprehensive panels measuring up to 50 biomarkers related to metabolic, cardiovascular, hormonal, and nutritional health from blood samples.

product.name: Health Data Integration and Dashboard
product.description: A digital platform that consolidates blood test results and wearable device data into a single dashboard for comprehensive health monitoring.

product.name: Personalized Health Recommendations and Coaching
product.description: A service providing personalized health insights and recommendations based on biomarker data, including 1:1 coaching sessions.

product.name: Health and Wellness Supplement Guidance
product.description: Recommendations for science-backed supplements tailored to individual biomarker profiles and health goals.
